cases.proposal: Build a standalone inspectable evidence-lineage product for claims, sources, contradictions, corrections and unknowns.

world_need.description: THR pressure cases require inspectable source dependence, translation/attribution and unresolved identity without promoting repetition into corroboration.
evidence: COM PR #376 and its four frozen THR interoperability fixtures

hard_cases.description: dependent repetition must not become independent corroboration
translation and attributed source criticism must remain bounded
reported distinctness must coexist with unresolved identity

owners.evidence: Unmodified alsoleg89/doubt v0.8.0 validator pinned in COM PR #376.

material_losses.description: Dedicated THR ancestry/reported-state/supersession semantics are compressed in Doubt's smaller contract.

uncovered_requirement.description: No consequential use failure from the observed compression was established.

cases.proposal: Build a compiler/evaluator that preserves unresolved, refused, withheld, non-authority, conflict and revocation states through machine policy/negotiation.

world_need.description: The experiment demonstrated only that an authored preserving compiler can reproduce its authored fixture states; no real compiler collapse causing a material wrong outcome was observed.

hard_cases.description: unresolved must not silently become negotiable
refusal must not become missing/default permission
withheld value must not be disclosed or inferred
revoked authority must not remain active

owners.evidence: Current DPV/ISO 27560, XACML, Cedar, ODRL and agent-authorization work preserve substantial status/reason/context/delegation semantics.

uncovered_requirement.description: No real requirement->policy pipeline failure remained after owner subtraction.

smallest_build.description: Run current model/compiler against synthetic fixtures.
smallest_build.kill_condition: Kill if fixtures mostly measure explicit cue-following or no real pipeline failure is observed.

cases.proposal: Build a tiny public-surface checker for contradictory lift-existence/currentness statements.

world_need.description: Three stations had current owner-controlled passenger summaries stating no lifts while another current owner-controlled surface necessarily evidenced lift existence; three controls did not show the contradiction.

hard_cases.description: existing-lift control should remain consistent despite separate outage information

owners.evidence: National Rail Accessibility Map/live lift data and station/operator accessibility surfaces own live operational/accessibility information.

material_losses.description: No owner tool/surface found in the bounded pass exposed the exact passenger-summary vs lift-existence contradiction as a consistency audit.

uncovered_requirement.description: A bounded owner-routable cross-surface existence/currentness consistency check remained.

smallest_build.description: Six-station existence/currentness checker with negation/fetch guards and an unsent owner correction packet.
smallest_build.kill_condition: Kill or shrink if owner fixes the data, current public fetches become too fragile, or an existing owner tool provides the same consistency check.
